summary: Iteration 3 backend-only review for new Accounting feature (allow_notes / multiple_entries flags + POST /api/accounting/entry/set). All 38/38 pytest tests pass (24 regression + 14 new). New tests cover: head flag persistence (allow_notes, multiple_entries, defaults False, backward-compat for pre-existing Cash head without flag fields), POST /api/accounting/entry/set with all three value shapes (number, dict {amount, note}, list of items), empty list, zero amount, junk-string coercion to 0.0, employee store-access enforcement (403), mixed-shape totals computation in GET /api/accounting/today (credits=210 across number+dict+list, debits=50, net=160, closing=160 with opening=0), legacy POST /api/accounting/entry still works, and rejection (400) of both /entry and /entry/set after submit. No regressions across stores, auth, scoping, WebSocket, chat history.
action_items: No backend blockers. Main agent can proceed with frontend implementation/verification of the Add Head modal (mutually exclusive Notes/Multi switches) and the multi-line entry UI.
critical_code_review_comments: AccountHeadCreate / AccountHead Pydantic models cleanly add `allow_notes: bool = False` and `multiple_entries: bool = False` with defaults — pre-existing Cash heads (without these fields in Mongo) deserialize correctly via Pydantic defaults; verified by test_existing_cash_head_has_flag_defaults.

EntryValueUpdate uses `value: Any = None`, which is permissive by design. _sanitize_entry_value() correctly clamps list size to 50 items, truncates notes to 1000 chars and labels to 120 chars, coerces invalid strings to 0.0, auto-generates item ids when missing — robust against malformed client payloads.

_entry_total() handles None, int/float, numeric string, dict({amount}), and list of dicts uniformly. Used by both /accounting/today and _compute_closing_for_date for opening-balance carry, so totals stay consistent across day boundaries.
Sanitizer drops the unknown bool branch to 0.0 (correct), and silently ignores non-dict items inside a list — could log a warning for observability but functionally safe.

Note: the flags on AccountHeadCreate are NOT mutually exclusive at the server level (both could be True simultaneously). UI is responsible for the mutual exclusion per spec. If business rule must be enforced server-side, add a validator. Currently this is acceptable since spec frames the constraint as UI-only.
server.py at ~830 lines is approaching the split threshold (700) — consider routers/accounting.py, routers/stores.py, routers/checklists.py, routers/chat.py in a future iteration.
Mongo _id excluded everywhere via projections; UUIDs used for all ids. Auth + store scoping unchanged and verified by regression tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests rely on auto-seeded Admin/1234 + Main Store with Cash credit head. New tests provision their own TEST_-prefixed isolated stores (with cleanup) so opening_balance starts at 0.0, plus temporary employee users for permission checks (with cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL env var: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. New endpoint POST /api/accounting/entry/set accepts {head_id, value} where value can be number | {amount, note} | list of {id?, label?, note?, amount}. Server sanitizes (caps list at 50, note 1000 chars, label 120 chars, auto-generates item ids). Server does NOT enforce mutual-exclusion of allow_notes/multiple_entries — UI-only constraint per spec. /api/accounting/today computes totals using _entry_total() which sums list items. Legacy /api/accounting/entry (number only) still supported. Both write paths return 400 after /api/accounting/submit. Frontend changes not tested this iteration.
